messages.subject: Energy, mining and infrastructure executive | Thailand and APAC
messages.body:
Dear NES Fircroft Bangkok Team,

Your client base across oil and gas, power, renewables, infrastructure, mining and chemicals makes NES Fircroft one of the strongest recruitment fits for my executive background.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy across a major gold-mining operation.

I also bring direct energy-transition experience through stakeholder and governance work around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, plus carbon-data readiness using physical operating records.

I am targeting senior Thailand, ASEAN and APAC mandates across Country Leadership, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and External Affairs. I have attached an NES Fircroft-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
